visa-dev-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: The hero carousel on the day carried a certificate-renewal notice with dates. Beneath it, six audience tiles route to the product browser, and Use Cases and Learning Hub sit beside them.

visa-dev-s5-06-20260925.webp.text: The self-service registration form, with the three steps stated on the right: create your account, verify and login, play in the sandbox.

visa-dev-s2-02-20260925.webp.text: Passkey or password tabs on the one wall that stands between the reader and a project.

mastercard-dev-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Products, Solutions, Resources and AI in the header. Open Finance leads the carousel with Learn more and View documentation.

visa-dev-s3-04-20260925.webp.text: Every product with Overview and Docs links, filters by six audiences and fifteen capabilities, and an SDKs & Tools column, all without an account.

mastercard-dev-s2-03-20260925.webp.text: Email, password, name, company and country, the Developer Program Agreement, and the three steps stated beside the form: create your account, verify your email address, create your first project.

mastercard-dev-s4-05-20260925.webp.text: The platform documentation includes an MCP server and SDK page, readable logged out, with the product sidebar and LLM resources on the left.

mastercard-dev-s7-08-20260925.webp.text: Direct contact needs an account. Guides, the forum, Engage and the MCP server are offered instead.

amex-dev-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Products, Support, Log In and Sign Up. Two featured products and the four-step path beneath the fold.

amex-dev-s3-02-20260925.webp.lead: Find the API that's right for your project.
amex-dev-s3-02-20260925.webp.text: Search and a capability filter (Fraud Prevention, Open Banking, Payment Services, Personalized Services, Utilities), with Overview and Docs per product.

amex-dev-s4-03-20260925.webp.text: Endpoints on the left, hosts and HMAC security in the middle, version history and Java and .NET samples on the right, readable logged out.

amex-dev-s7-04-20260925.webp.text: A ticket form usable without an account, with hours stated in Eastern time and two attachments allowed.

dgn-site-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Three brands under one network. Our Network, Solutions, Resources, Insights, Contact Us, Search and Log In in the header.

dgn-site-s3-03-20260925.webp.lead: Accept Our Network, the acceptance page.
dgn-site-s3-03-20260925.webp.text: For merchants and acquirers. Figures on this page read 378 million cards and 622 billion dollars of spend opportunity for 2024, against 439 million and 634 billion on the landing.

dgn-site-s6-04-20260925.webp.text: Merchant levels with validation and reporting per level, and the Security Compliance Innovation Program named.

dgn-dev-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: A gateway: a welcome line, one button to the Partner Product Portal, Contact Us, FAQ and Log In. No product list and no documentation link.

dgn-dev-s2-03-20260925.webp.text: Access as a new user goes through the Contact Us form. Collaborators are added by invitation from a Discover representative. Products appear after log in.

dgn-dev-s2-02-20260925.webp.text: Subject line, description, email and a captcha. The form is the way in.

dgn-partner-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Explore our APIs, Going Live with Discover and Partner Resources in the header. Two featured token services and Explore all products.

dgn-partner-s3-03-20260925.webp.text: Twelve products in six groups, each with Overview and API Spec, readable logged out.

dgn-partner-s2-02-20260925.webp.text: The page that names the family's portals: the Release Compliance Tool for testing and certification, the Disputes Portal, the Developer Center, EASI and Web Merchant Boarding.

dgn-easi-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: The acquirer and processor portal opens on Secure Account Log In, with Join Now and a Registration Quick Guide PDF beside it.

diners-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: A cardmember site. For Cardmembers, For Businesses, About Us, Club Connections and Help Center.

diners-s3-03-20260925.webp.text: Card programmes, cardless solutions and the Tracker reporting tool for corporate clients. Partnering is a country search and a contact link.

pulse-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: <q>Log In / Register</q>, <q>Client Support</q> and <q>Find ATMs</q> above the nav. <q>Why PULSE</q>, <q>What We Offer</q>, <q>Partner With Us</q>, <q>Resources and Insights</q>, <q>Connect With Us</q>.

pulse-s3-03-20260925.webp.text: The service catalogue as pages: Payments Network, ATM Network, Discover Debit, Processing and Gateways, Fraud Detection, Partner Support Services.

pulse-s5-04-20260925.webp.text: User ID and password on the left. On the right the registration path in three steps, with credentials promised within five business days.

pulse-s7-05-20260925.webp.text: A phone number, hours in Central time, and named mailboxes for account management, DebitProtect, disputes and the processor portal.

jcb-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Consumers, Businesses, Merchants, Products, Press and About Us. The partner site, JCB Partner Online, is a login named under Businesses.

unionpay-open-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Products, API Market, Tech Support, Documents, Service Center, Guide, Login and Register Now, with agentic payment solutions leading the hero on the day.

interac-hub-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Solutions, Community, Guides and Support. The footnote says access to specific products needs an existing relationship with an issuing financial institution.

eftpos-dev-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: One portal for BPAY, eftpos and NPP with a self-service Get started, and a password-reset note for users of the three portals it replaced.

elo-dev-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Soluções, APIs, Tutoriais, Central de Ajuda, Entrar and Cadastrar, with a notice that the developer portal is being modernised.

shazam-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: <q>Who We Serve</q>, <q>Products</q>, <q>Resources</q>, <q>Who We Are</q> and <q>Contact</q>. The Login menu names five client tools.

nyce-fis-s1-01-20260925.webp.lead: NYCE on the FIS product site.
nyce-fis-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: <q>About</q>, <q>Benefits</q>, <q>Client video</q>, <q>Client story</q>, <q>Resources</q> and <q>Contact us</q>. The calls to action are <q>Contact us</q> and <q>Request a demo</q>.

star-fiserv-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: A product page under Fiserv's payment networks, with a contact route and brochures.

girocard-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Für Unternehmen routes system partners by type. Product development sits behind a download login.

culiance-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: A cardholder page about surcharge-free ATMs. Credit union material sits under Credit Unions.

affn-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: A member-network site for military-affiliated institutions, with a 250th anniversary mark on the day.

rupay-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: A consumer site. Partner material lives on npci.org.in under Business, Developer Studio and Circulars.

mastercard-status-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Every service listed with its health for the last twenty-four hours, and a Sandbox and Production toggle, readable logged out.

visa-notes-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Monthly entries by year back to 2017, each tagged public or restricted.

amex-docs-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Updated June 1, 2026. It says some products' API documentation is locked for security reasons and some products are not listed publicly at all.

dgn-fraudrisk-s1-01-20260925.webp.lead: Fraud and Risk Center Log In.
dgn-fraudrisk-s1-01-20260925.webp.text: Where the marketing site's Log In lands. The side panel names EASI, the Advanced Payments Providers portal, eCentral and the Disputes Portal.
